biotools.summary: FuncZymeDB is a resource that utilizes an LLM-assisted workflow to mine enzyme-substrate interactions from published manuscripts, particularly focusing on plant enzymes. It aims to improve biocuration and prediction of enzyme functions by extracting data from the literature.
